demand_drivers: Diwali home lighting decor and traditional festive gifting
Dhanteras custom favoring the purchase of metallic goods
High demand for return gifts during weddings and Griha Pravesh (housewarming) ceremonies
Cultural resonance and auspicious value of the traditional peacock motif
Strong appeal of antique gold finish metal decor on e-commerce craft platforms
inventory_recommendation: Artisans should begin raw material sourcing in May–June and ramp up production to peak inventory levels by August to capture early festive and corporate gifting orders ahead of Diwali. Maintain moderate stock levels through January for the winter wedding trade, then scale down production between April and July to avoid excessive holding costs.
trend_summary: Based on an AI-estimated market analysis, this product shows strong demand driven by its dual function as functional lighting and decorative giftware. The peacock motif paired with a metallic finish creates high seasonal spikes during Diwali and the winter wedding season, with steady baseline sales driven by housewarming and home styling trends.
